core: Pathogen manipulation of host epithelial cells
qualifier: bacterial attachment and entry plus SARS-CoV targeting of junctions and signalling
name: Bacterial entry and SARS-CoV targeting of host epithelial junctions
rationale: All members concern pathogens engaging host cells (bacterial attachment/entry incl. Listeria InlA, actin-based motility, Gram-positive response, SARS-CoV PDZ-junction and signalling targeting, LRRFIP1 IFN sensing), unlike confusables centred on viral protein maturation or Mtb phagosome subversion.

qualifier: recruitment and loss of centrosomal proteins with AURKA activation
name: Mitotic centrosome maturation and protein recruitment
rationale: All members are steps of centrosome maturation at mitotic entry (NuMA and protein recruitment, Nlp loss, TPX2-AURKA activation), distinct from confusables on spindle orientation, centrosome positioning/microtubule nucleation and PLK1/NEK mitotic kinase signalling.

qualifier: methylmalonyl-CoA mutase defects (MUT, MMAA, MMAB)
name: Propionyl-CoA catabolism and methylmalonyl-CoA mutase defects
rationale: All members concern conversion of propionyl-CoA via methylmalonyl-CoA mutase and its inherited defects causing methylmalonic acidemia, unlike confusables on upstream cobalamin transport/processing or branched-chain amino acid catabolism disorders.

qualifier: de novo purine/pyrimidine synthesis, deoxyribonucleotides and pyrimidine catabolism
name: Nucleotide de novo synthesis, interconversion and pyrimidine catabolism
rationale: All members concern purine and pyrimidine (deoxy)nucleotide synthesis, phosphorylation and breakdown, distinguished from confusables by de novo IMP/AMP/GMP and pyrimidine synthesis, dNTP production and pyrimidine catabolism rather than purine salvage, nucleoside transport or drug metabolism.

qualifier: FRS/SHC adaptor-mediated MAPK cascade and its feedback regulation
name: FGF receptor FRS/SHC-MAPK signalling and its regulation
rationale: All members concern FGFR activation and adaptor (FRS2/SHC)-driven MAPK signalling with Sprouty/FGFRL1 and positive/negative regulation, distinct from confusables built on PI3K/PLC-gamma FGFR branches or generic RAS-MAPK attenuation.

qualifier: essential metals (zinc, copper, manganese, iron) via MTF1 and metallothioneins
name: MTF1-metallothionein response to zinc, copper and manganese
rationale: Members are cellular responses to essential transition metals with MTF1-driven metallothionein expression and metal binding, distinguished from confusables on cadmium/mercury detoxification, zinc or copper transport and ROS detoxification.

qualifier: metabolic remodelling with activity, inactivity and glucocorticoids (PGC-1alpha, fibre-type switch)
name: Skeletal muscle metabolic adaptation to activity and inactivity
rationale: Members concern skeletal muscle adaptation to use and disuse (atrophy, fast-slow fibre transition, PGC-1alpha activation, dexamethasone response, energy/nucleotide catabolism), distinct from confusables on cardiac adaptation, hypertrophy and muscle growth/regeneration.

qualifier: AP-1 and NR4A growth-factor/TNF-induced genes
name: AP-1 and NR4A immediate-early gene response
rationale: Members are immediate-early stimulus-induced transcription programmes (AP-1 activation and network, NR4A growth-factor-induced module, TNF-NF-kB targets, growth arrest genes), distinct from confusables on ARE-mediated mRNA decay, UV/PI3K responses and upstream JNK/p38 kinase activation.

core: Selenium metabolism and thyroid hormone activity
qualifier: selenocysteine synthesis and readthrough linked to thyroid hormone signalling
name: Selenium metabolism, selenocysteine synthesis and thyroid hormone signalling
rationale: Members cover dietary selenium metabolism, selenocysteine synthesis/recoding and thyroid hormone generation, transport and receptor signalling (selenoprotein deiodinases link the two), distinct from confusables on iodide/sulfate anion transport and hydrogen peroxide metabolism.

qualifier: pregnenolone to progesterone, androgens and estrogens (aromatase)
name: Sex steroid biosynthesis from pregnenolone to estrogens
rationale: Members cover synthesis of pregnenolone, progesterone, androgens and estrogens including aromatase deficiency and androgen catabolism, distinct from confusables on gluco/mineralocorticoid biosynthesis and adrenal CYP enzyme defects.

qualifier: dietary antioxidants vitamin C, vitamin E and selenium
name: Vitamin C, vitamin E and selenium antioxidant redox defence
rationale: Members concern ROS detoxification and redox homeostasis together with ascorbate metabolism/transport and responses to vitamin E and selenium, distinct from confusables on BH4/NO synthase, thyroid H2O2, iron/oxygen sensing or NADPH-aldehyde detoxification.

qualifier: Hox cluster expression in hindbrain and neural plate
name: Hox-driven hindbrain and neural plate axial patterning
rationale: Members concern early embryonic body-axis and neural plate/border patterning with Hox cluster modules and anterior Hox activation in rhombomeres, distinct from confusables on axial mesoderm/notochord, somitogenesis and craniofacial/limb organogenesis that lack the Hox clusters.

qualifier: ubiquitinated receptor (EGFR) downregulation and exosome release
name: ESCRT multivesicular body sorting, receptor downregulation and exosome release
rationale: Members concern ESCRT-dependent MVB biogenesis sorting ubiquitinated cargo such as EGFR for lysosomal degradation or exosome/non-lytic release, distinct from confusables on autophagy-lysosome fusion and ESCRT-III roles in viral budding, abscission and nuclear envelope sealing.

qualifier: LDL/VLDL receptor endocytosis limiting cholesterol uptake
name: Lipoprotein receptor internalization and degradation in cholesterol uptake
rationale: Members concern clathrin-mediated receptor internalization, reduced recycling and lysosomal degradation, centred on LDLR/VLDLR clearance and LXR-limited cholesterol uptake, distinct from confusables on lipase-driven lipoprotein remodelling, SREBP cholesterol sensing and generic endocytosis inhibition.

core: Proteasomal protein degradation and its regulation
qualifier: ribosome-associated quality control and stress granule dynamics
name: Proteasomal degradation, ribosome quality control and stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members concern proteasome function and regulation of ubiquitin-dependent and degron-rule proteolysis together with ribosome-stall quality control and stress granule assembly/disassembly, distinct from confusables on ERAD/misfolded protein and aggrephagy, ubiquitin chain types, or PKR/PML stress signalling.

core: Response to reactive oxygen and nitrogen species
qualifier: gasotransmitters (nitric oxide, hydrogen sulfide) and ischemia
name: Response to nitric oxide, hydrogen sulfide, peroxide and ischemia
rationale: Members are cellular responses to reactive gases and oxidants (NO/RNS, H2S, H2O2, oxygen) and ischemia, distinct from confusables on oxidative-stress-induced apoptosis, ferroptosis and ROS detoxification enzymes.

qualifier: lymphocyte homing into lymphoid organs and B cell chemotaxis
name: Lymphocyte homing and chemotaxis into lymphoid organs
rationale: Members concern T, B and dendritic cell chemotaxis and adhesion-dependent homing to lymphoid organs (with Cdc42 and PLC/PKC signalling and marginal zone B cell positioning), distinct from confusables on chemokine-receptor binding modules and S1P/lymph node development.

qualifier: with aggresome formation and aggrephagy
name: Stress granule dynamics and aggresome clearance by aggrephagy
rationale: Members concern assembly, protein recruitment and disassembly of stress granules together with aggresome assembly and aggrephagy, distinct from confusables on ribosome quality control, degron proteolysis, ERAD and chaperone-mediated autophagy.

qualifier: transcription of death genes and positive control of p53 expression and activity
name: p53-dependent apoptotic gene transcription and p53 activation
rationale: Members concern p53 transcriptional induction of apoptotic genes (cytochrome c release, death receptors, caspases) and positive regulation of p53 expression, cofactors and COP1 turnover, distinct from confusables on p53-driven G1 arrest/p21 and negative regulation of p53 apoptosis.

qualifier: outer membrane translocation into the matrix
name: Mitochondrial protein import through outer membrane into matrix
rationale: Members concern import of proteins into mitochondria and their outer membrane organization and matrix targeting, distinct from confusables on mitochondrial protein processing/degradation, inner membrane insertion and respiratory complex assembly, or cristae formation.

core: Transition metal ion transport and homeostasis
qualifier: zinc (SLC30/SLC39), copper and manganese
name: Zinc, copper and manganese transport and homeostasis
rationale: Members concern membrane transport, compartmentalization and intracellular homeostasis of zinc, copper and manganese including SLC39A4 and ceruloplasmin defects, distinct from confusables on cadmium detoxification, metallothioneins and iron export.

qualifier: carnitine transport and carnitine shuttle
name: Carnitine transport and shuttle supporting fatty acid oxidation
rationale: Members concern carnitine uptake (SLC22A5 deficiency), the carnitine shuttle and promotion of fatty acid beta-oxidation, distinct from confusables on monocarboxylate/fatty acid membrane transport, ketone bodies and malonyl-CoA inhibition of oxidation.

qualifier: tooth odontogenesis and hair follicle placode formation
name: Tooth odontogenesis and hair follicle placode development
rationale: Members concern development of ectodermal appendages, namely odontoblast differentiation, dentin/cementum formation and hair follicle placode formation, distinct from confusables on EDA/NF-kB ectodermal dysplasia, tooth eruption, and epidermis, nail and gland development.

qualifier: inner and outer ear development (otic vesicle, cochlea, semicircular canals)
name: Craniofacial and inner ear morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern embryonic head, face and skull morphogenesis together with otic vesicle, cochlea, semicircular canal, ear and vestibulocochlear nerve formation, distinct from confusables on cranial/olfactory nerve development and pharyngeal gland or palate organogenesis.

qualifier: negative feedback on IFN-beta and cGAS-STING
name: Type I interferon signalling and negative feedback on cGAS-STING
rationale: Members concern the type I IFN/IFN-beta response and its restraint (negative regulation of IFN-beta production, IFNAR signalling and cGAS-STING, TREX1), distinct from confusables centred on IRF3 induction of interferon and RIG-I/MDA5 sensing.
